snippet.title: Drops of Death | A Killer Dating Sim | 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Drops of Death is a mystery visual novel where the killer is randomly selected at the start of the game, but there's a romantic twist, you might accidentally end up dating them! Coming to Steam on August 7th, 2025 for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404300/Drops_of_Death/?utm_source=Youtube&utm_medium=2025_trailerdescription&utm_campaign=2025_launch&utm_content=2025youtubetrailer
